planner_decision: b14 r0 board (150 valid v5 packets, bad_xor=0, CAM sel=0, bit20=0) now shows the A camera fully working: cap_frames=4470, pix_beats growing normally, crop_short=0, crop_geom_err=0, raw_pub=4470. But every A+ read attempt costs timeout=13,410 (3/frame), retry=8,940 (2/frame), giveup=4,470 (1/frame), enc=0, exported=0, with ar=17,213,681 vs r=17,200,031 - i.e. exactly one R short per attempt (H4 reproduced deterministically). The read path is therefore the only blocker. Root-cause hypothesis grounded in the frozen source: ar_pending is cleared on the FIRST R handshake instead of paxi_rlast, so 'one outstanding AR' is only nominal - a second AR can be accepted while the previous burst is still returning, and a late beat arriving with r_expected=0 is swallowed (paxi_rready=1 but rf_push=0). This package changes exactly one file, p2_ddr_bridge.v: (R1) ar_busy set on the AR handshake and cleared ONLY on rvalid&&rready&&rlast; (R2) issue a new AR only when !ar_busy AND AF has a request AND the read-data path is empty (rf_level==0 and skid empty, cross-domain toggle) AND ddr_rdy AND !rd_hold; (R3) paxi_rready is 1 at all times (overflow is prevented by the AR pre-condition, never by rready back-pressure); (R4) every beat of an owned burst is pushed (no swallowed beats); (R5) b13 TIMEOUT=8192 / RETRY_MAX=2 / A1_GUARD_N=70000 / BRIDGE_GUARD_N=65536 / purge semantics preserved verbatim as the fallback. MAX_OS stays 1 (2 only if sim proves 1 cannot sustain >=77.76 MB/s AND R attribution stays unambiguous, recorded as an explicit deviation). Status packet v5 stays byte-identical at 241 B / 59 fields - no new field; outstanding is read off the existing ar_cnt - rlast_cnt. Baseline is the b13 r1 A-path source set (p2_a1_board_top.v 48881D57... is the A-only version that actually ran on the board; b14's CAM_SEL generate variant is NOT merged this round), so the b14 B-selection diff is parked as a follow-up theme and the B front-end code stays inside the camera core exactly as it is today (u_csi_b/u_cfg_b instantiated but not selected).

gates.single_ar: ar_busy set on the AR handshake and cleared only on paxi_rvalid && paxi_rready && paxi_rlast (plus the existing purge/guard force-clear); no AR is issued while a burst is in flight; af_pop only on the AR handshake (except purge).
gates.rready: paxi_rready is constant 1; no beat of an owned burst can be dropped; overflow is structurally impossible because an AR is only issued when the read-data path is empty (or rf_level <= DEPTH - L_max with evidenced L_max).
gates.no_rf_overflow: RF (256b x 16) never overflows; if L_max > 16 the only permitted change is the instantiation ADDR_BITS 4->5, recorded with its resource cost; otherwise stop.

gates.drop_recovery: S2: exactly one timeout then one successful retry then exported=1 with a golden-matching CRC; the late R is counted as stale, never queued; dup=0.
